fields.description: One by Binghatti is a canal-side residential tower in Business Bay. Its collection extends from studios and apartments to pool villas and royal penthouses. The larger homes have different outdoor spaces and specifications from the standard apartment layouts.

reviewCoverage.identity: Own project page and linked original One documents; not another Binghatti Business Bay development.
reviewCoverage.location: Business Bay confirmed by primary page; portal FAQ mistakenly says Downtown in investment prose, not adopted.
reviewCoverage.residences: Brochure includes studios, one/two/three-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom pool villas and four-bedroom royal penthouses; FAQ shorthand alone is incomplete.
reviewCoverage.areas: Actual brochure visible plans 35–40 inspected, including repeated duplex villa totals and royal penthouse area table; not added twice.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own amenities-floor plan reviewed; private lap pools restricted to drawn selected homes.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Own hero advertises AED 2m; portal FAQ AED 2,574,999 versus rounded 2.6m headline. Current unit quote unconfirmed.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own FAQ 20/50/30 corroborated by portal, totals 100. No current primary dated monthly calendar retrieved.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own Q4 2026 and portal December 2026 forecasts align; no completed or handed-over claim.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own 43-page brochure and 10-page facts downloaded; repeated content pooled at 195 words. Suite/balcony/total distinctions retained.

overview: The brochure lists 647 residential homes, including 192 studios, 220 one-bedroom, 186 two-bedroom, 31 three-bedroom apartments, 10 pool villas and eight royal penthouses. Nine shops are separate. Planned counts do not establish current availability.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai Water Canal setting. A portal FAQ’s Downtown wording conflicts with the developer location; Business Bay is retained.
research.priceNote: The developer hero advertises from AED 2m. Property Finder gives AED 2,574,999 in its FAQ and rounds its headline to AED 2.6m. These different guides do not establish current unit availability or a personalised quotation.
research.paymentNote: The developer states 20% on signing, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Confirm a dated unit schedule, outstanding balance and all additional charges.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets Q4 2026; Property Finder specifies December 2026. This remains a forecast pending current contractual and completion evidence.
